articles.headline: Who could challenge Gianni Infantino for FIFA presidency?
articles.description: Rivals are reportedly circling in a bid to unseat Gianni Infantino as FIFA president following his disastrous plan to bring private equity into the World Cup. Who are they and what makes them viable candidates to run against him?

articles.description: Gianni Infantino has called an emergency meeting of FIFA staff in Rabat on Wednesday as pressure on the president ramps up, the Press Association understands.
